areas.name: Women
areas.reason: No direct link in the general objective; a pilot training product for vulnerable groups has a tiny resource share, with indicator and target; impact minor.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: Rural-access objective focused on traditional communities, with indicator and target; resources not identified, impact minor; efficient solutions.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Relevant general objective; components with most resources include urban crossings, pedestrian areas and mobility planning; indicator and target exist; high impact and efficient solutions.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: Road-safety objective with indicator and target on fatalities; small resource share; high impact and efficient solutions, but only indirect link to public safety.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Relevant objective with indicators on climate-response plans and critical-point treatment; very small resource share, so impact minor; efficient solutions.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Relevant objective with drainage-based water-availability indicator; resources not identified, impact minor; efficiency of solutions not shown.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Asset-management capacity building with performance-based contracts, training and monitoring indicators; impact deemed exceptional and structuring, but very small resource share.

areas.name: Anti-racism
areas.reason: Objectives and indicators overlap with the women's area; no specific racial-equality features, so impact and efficiency are not demonstrated.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Indicators address maintenance, safety and resilience, not decarbonization; impact and efficiency not demonstrated.

areas.name: Labor

areas.name: Clean energy

areas.name: Regional equity

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: No relation to the area; objectives, indicators and targets do not show it.

areas.name: Digital government
